plugins.name: a1-lane
plugins.description: Draft, schedule and publish social posts and videos, with per-destination delivery receipts and platform read-back verification where available. Works today with YouTube, X, Pinterest, Bluesky, Mastodon, Discord and Telegram, plus LinkedIn personal profiles (limited). Facebook Pages, Instagram, Threads and TikTok are coming once each platform approves our app.
